card.config_read: ettelem config through the kit's guard at the start and the end, holding the card's lock under timeout 10: expected TDP 65 W, threshold 65 C and 600 MHz at rest (as E190 arm A read it, Fri 13 Nov 2026: 65 W, 65 C, 600 MHz, 519 mV, low_power); a different TDP, threshold or rest clock at the start stops the session before its first launch (a gate: no data, and the governor is not touched); the end reading is reported
card.governor: as found: under load it climbs to 800 MHz (the forecast's clock) while the shires' mean is at most 65 C and the board's ~1 s average under the TDP; nothing of it is set, reset or read beyond ettelem config and ettelem sample

card.which: aifoundry2 card 0 (the ledger's card 'aifoundry2'), its own governor as found; nothing set, reads only; the box this round's orchestration runs on

c_arithmetic.how: a pass = 8 s idle + the host process (set-up, K launches, its checks) + 10 s idle + the sampler's start and stop (3 s) + bookkeeping (5 s); the rest of the 50 minutes is the die gate's waits (heat carries over) and the sampler's retries

card_minutes.d_note: E189's kit dropped the counters arm (its KIT.md section 5): its 6 card-minutes go unused
card_minutes.rule: about 95 card-minutes, cap 110 (E189's): no pass starts after 108 card-minutes from the first card command; the session ends by 110. The clock shortens every cycle-bound burst (x 600/800) and changes no step, so the estimate and the cap stand

clock_rule.evidence: E190 arm A (13 Nov 2026), 84 processes: the first 800 MHz sample came 0.014-1.325 s after the launch window's start (median 0.852 s); in its 12 burst processes no sample left 800 MHz after it (desk/climb-e190.txt)
pass_counts_if: every busy sample (the reducer's window [lo + 0.5 s, hi]) at or after lo + 1.5 s reads 800 MHz
the burst's last launch ran at 800 MHz by its own count: its slowest minion's cycles over its wall seconds read 780-810 MHz
clock_rule.reducer_line: the reducer's hard line 'minion clock in busy samples' is read by this rule, not as a failure; every other hard check stands
clock_rule.t_k: the last launch's slowest-minion cycles over 800 MHz

die_gate.rule: a pass starts only when minshire[0] reads 57 C or less (waits up to 10 minutes, then the pass is skipped, no data); a die below 46 C does not block (the pass is scored given its own T0 and labelled 'T0 below the forecast band')
die_gate.why: stricter than E189's 60 C for the clock: the governor steps down when the shires' mean passes 65 C; E136's burst law (die_max = die_start + 0.1445 (P - 21.5)) puts the hottest burst's rise at about 5 C at its predicted board power with E136's base

order.rule: four independent passes a configuration, one host process each; each round holds every configuration once, shuffled by random.Random(194); written out here, never re-drawn
sequence: the counters arm: not run (E189's kit dropped it, its KIT.md section 5)
the closing reads (ettelem config: TDP, threshold, clock at rest), release

peaks.how: points: P_idle(55 C) + W over idle + its rise at the point; bands' top: P_idle(57 C) + 0.5 W + the largest W over idle a band allows + its rise at k_leak(57 C) x 1.25 x 0.20 C a W; E136's base difference (B(800) - B(600)) added to both as an outside term

aifoundry2_lines.rule: E190 arm A's lines on this card, kept beside E189's: board above 85 W on 3 samples in a row, or the shires' mean or the latch minshire[2] at or above 80 C, ends the queue the same way (E189's lines bind first; minshire[2] read 70 C throughout E190 arm A, so it is never read against the 70 C line)

stops.clock: the governor's climb: in each burst the samples from its first launch's start + 1.5 s to its last launch's end must read 800 MHz; the first pass with one off it is set aside; a second such pass (any configuration) stops the session (the card is not at the forecast's clock)
stops.rule: E189's runner's lines: a live sample at or above 65 W board or 70 C on minshire[0] ends the queue: the running process finishes (never killed), no further pass starts, the closing reads, release
